6 Best Dog Thermometers 2022 – Reviews & Top Picks
When you notice your dog isn’t feeling well, it’s nice to have a thermometer available so you can take their temperature right away. This way, you’ll have information for your veterinarian if a visit is warranted. Or, perhaps you need a dependable thermometer to keep track of impending labor with your female dog.
Either way, having the best thermometer on hand will save you time and help you take care of your dog when they are ill. This reviews list features the six best dog thermometers that are easy to use and reliable. The buyer’s guide has a few considerations to keep in mind when choosing a thermometer, so you can find the right one for you and your dog.

The LCD display is easy to read, and the thermometer has memory to store temperature readings for easy reference.
You will want to clean the thermometer after each use, which is done by washing it with warm water and soap. Avoid immersing it entirely in water in order to prevent it from malfunctioning. The temperature range is from 89.6 to 109.4 degrees Fahrenheit, which is good enough to determine any illness in your dog.
An alarm will sound when the temperature is completed, and the thermometer will shut off automatically. On the downside, the Aurynns will not show results in Celsius, only Fahrenheit. But we found it to be accurate, and it offers a user-friendly design that is easy to hold and maneuver. A battery is included with the purchase.

It is perfect to use with any large-eared animal, such as cats, horses, and rabbits.
